question: A person travels equal distances at speeds of 5 km/h, 8 km/h and 10 km/h and takes a total time of 61 min 12 sec. The total distance travelled by the person is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed for 3 equal distances at speeds a, b, c = 3abc ÷ (ab + bc + ca)

Average speed = (3 × 5 × 8 × 10) ÷ (40 + 80 + 50) = 1200 ÷ 170 = 120/17 km/h.

Total Time = 61 min 12 sec = 306/5 mins = 51/50 hours.

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time = (120/17) × (51/50) = 7.2 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speeds = 5 km/h, 8 km/h, 10 km/h

Total time = 61 min 12 sec

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total distance be 3d, so each equal part is d km.

⇒ Total Time = 61 min + 12 sec = 61 + 12/60 = 61 + 1/5 = 306/5 mins.

⇒ Total Time in hours = (306/5) × (1/60) = 306/300 = 51/50 hours.

⇒ Time taken for each part = d/5, d/8, and d/10.

⇒ Total Time = d/5 + d/8 + d/10 = 51/50

⇒ Taking LCM of 5, 8, 10 which is 40:

⇒ (8d + 5d + 4d) / 40 = 51/50

⇒ 17d / 40 = 51/50

⇒ d = (51/50) × (40/17)

⇒ d = 3 × (4/5) = 12/5 = 2.4 km

⇒ Total Distance = 3d = 3 × 2.4 = 7.2 km

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

When a body travels n equal distances at speeds v₁, v₂, ... vₙ, Average Speed = n ÷ (1/v₁ + 1/v₂ + ... + 1/vₙ).

Average Speed for Equal Time

When a body travels at speeds v₁, v₂, ... vₙ for equal time intervals, Average Speed = (v₁ + v₂ + ... + vₙ) ÷ n.

Relative Speed

For two bodies moving in the same direction, relative speed = |v₁ − v₂|. In opposite directions, relative speed = v₁ + v₂.
